description: Array of route records nested under a parent. Their components render in the parent's own `<RouterView />`.
Every matched record from root to leaf. Useful for breadcrumbs, guards and inherited `meta`.
`<RouterView name="sidebar" />` paired with `components: { default, sidebar }` in a record.
Replaces the target location with another one (string, location object or function).
Another URL that renders the same record without changing the address bar.
